{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "airline_competitive_advantage",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "crew_service_quality", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Quality of crew/staff service is a genuine constitutive aspect of an airline's competitive advantage in service delivery."},
    {"name": "crew_above_and_beyond", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Exceptional discretionary crew effort is an aspect of service advantage, though it overlaps heavily with crew_service_quality (the 'exceptional' level captures the same phenomenon)."},
    {"name": "personalized_service", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Personalization is a distinct dimension of service advantage, though partly overlapping with crew quality/above-and-beyond."},
    {"name": "service_consistency", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Reliability/consistency of service delivery is a legitimate aspect of the advantage, and reasonably distinct from raw quality."},
    {"name": "food_quality", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Catering quality is a core product facet of an airline's offering and advantage."},
    {"name": "seat_comfort_perception", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Seat/cabin comfort is a core constitutive facet of the flying-experience advantage."},
    {"name": "ife_quality", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Inflight entertainment is a distinct product facet of the onboard advantage."},
    {"name": "amenity_provision", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Provision of amenities is a distinct tangible facet of the onboard product advantage."}
  ],
  "facet_columns": ["crew_service_quality", "crew_above_and_beyond", "personalized_service", "service_consistency", "food_quality", "seat_comfort_perception", "ife_quality", "amenity_provision"],
  "non_facet_columns": [],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.6,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.7,
  "rationale": "All added columns are genuine part-of facets of 'airline competitive advantage' as an onboard service/product concept; none are external predictors, causes, or restatements of the whole. Mutual exclusivity is moderate: the four crew/service columns (crew_service_quality, crew_above_and_beyond, personalized_service, service_consistency) overlap substantially, with 'above_and_beyond' and 'personalized' largely subsumed by the quality dimension, over-weighting the human-service aspect. Exhaustiveness is fairly good for the onboard-experience dimensions (crew, food, seat, IFE, amenities) but misses other constitutive facets of competitive advantage such as value-for-money/price, on-time performance/reliability, route network/schedule, and booking/ground experience, so it captures the product-experience portion but not the full concept."
}
